effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [Ice-Snow] trait, by suspending this Tamer, trash any 1 digivolution card from your opponent's Digimon.
